test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Vice-President of India is part of which branch of the government?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both Executive and Legislative**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Vice-President of India is the **ex-officio Chairperson of the Rajya Sabha**, thus playing a legislative role in the Parliament.
 
• In the absence of the President, the Vice-President functions as the **acting President of India**, thereby assuming an executive role.
 
• The Vice-President is elected by an electoral college consisting of members of both Houses of Parliament through a process of **proportional representation by means of a single transferable vote**.
 
• As the Chairperson of the Rajya Sabha, the Vice-President ensures the smooth functioning of the Upper House of Parliament.
 
• The Vice-President's role is unique as it bridges the **executive and legislative branches of the government**, making the position integral to India's governance structure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Constitutional Provisions:**

 
 
• The Vice-President's office is established under **Article 63** of the Indian Constitution.
 
• Articles **64 to 71** provide details regarding the election, qualifications, and removal of the Vice-President.
 
 
 
• **Election Process:**
 
 
• The Vice-President is not elected by the general public but by an **electoral college** comprising members of Parliament.
 
• To be eligible, a candidate must be an Indian citizen, at least **35 years old**, and qualified to be elected as a Rajya Sabha member.
 
 
 
• **Legislative Role:**
 
 
• As Chairperson of the Rajya Sabha, the Vice-President presides over its sessions, maintaining decorum and ensuring legislative procedures are followed.
 
• In case of a tie in voting in Rajya Sabha, the Vice-President casts the **decisive vote.**
 
 
 
• **Executive Role:**
 
 
• The Vice-President assumes the role of **acting President** in case of the President's death, resignation, removal, or incapacity.
 
• During this period, the Vice-President exercises all executive powers of the President.
